Parameter.name: APPLICATION
Parameter.Description: Class name of application this page belongs to.

XData.name: Style
XData.Description: This Style block contains page-specific CSS style definitions.
XData.Data:
<style type="text/css">
 body { font-family: arial; }

     table.tpTable caption{
       background: transparent;
       font-size: 1.4em;
       font-weight: bold;
       text-align: left;
       border: none;
     }

    /* even rows */
     .tpEven { color: black; background: #ebf3ff; }
    
    /* odd rows */
     .tpOdd { color: black; background: white; }

    /* this is a selected row */
     table.tpTable tr.tpSelected { background: #3d80df; color: white; }
   
    /* hover for odd and even rows */
     tr.tpOdd:hover,tr.tpEven:hover { 
        background-color: #3d80df; 
        color: #ffffff; }
  
    /* table header style */
    table.tpTable th {
        border-right: 1px solid gray;
        border-bottom: 1px solid gray;
        background: #C5D6D6;
        color: black;
        font-weight: bold;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 2px;
        overflow: hidden;
     }

    /* selected column header (th) */
     table.tpTable th.tpHdrSelected { background: #3d80df; }

    /* filter layout */
     table.tpFilterLayout td { border: none; background: #C5D6D6; }

/*fieldSet styles*/
.fieldset{
     background: #FFFFFF;
     border: solid 5px #C5D6D6;
     color: #000000;
     font-size: 1em;
     font-family: arial;
}
/*text control styles*/
.text
{  
    font-size: .8em;
    font-family: arial;
    color: #000000;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    padding: 2px;
    border: solid 1px grey;
    margin-right: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
    height: 25px;
}
.Navigator {
	color:green;
	padding:5px;
	font-family:Verdana;
	font-size:15px;
}


</style>

XData.name: Contents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this pane.
XData.Data:
<page xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" title="Interface Team Login"> <label id="title" value="Source Control History"/> <cssGroup> <pane id="tPane"> <label id="infoLbl" align="left"/> <spacer height="10"/> <radioSet id="rId" name="QueryType" displayList="Implementation, Classes Information" valueList="I,C" onclick="zenPage.repopulateTable()"/>
<dataCombo id="comp" align="left" label="Component" editable="false" sql="select ComponentName from Component" onchange="zenPage.repopulateTable();"/> <tablePane width="80%" id="deployments" pageSize="25" maxRows="1000" showRowNumbers="true" showZebra="true" useSnapshot="true" OnCreateResultSet="CreateRS" >
</tablePane> </pane> </cssGroup> </page>

Method.name: repopulateTable
setSessionValues
Method.Implementation:
set qt = %page.%GetValueById("rId") set compNm = %page.%GetValueById("comp")
set %session.Data("QueryType") = qt set %session.Data("Component") = compNm
return $$$OK
